title: Stumbling on a brass band parade near General Ogden Street
summary: In 1951 Steinau heard a parade near his apartment; Allen talks about parades around town and how he learned of them.

bands.name: Joe Avery and Wilbur Tillman's band

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
